## Sales & Pricing

- POLICY: Accepted work: TCR takes bathroom remodels, kitchen remodels, and home additions (single- and multi-story). Ground-up new construction is a hard no; commercial or exterior-only work is evaluated case-by-case.
- REFERENCE: Service area
  Label: Center | Value: Johnson City, TN
  Label: Radius | Value: 45 | Unit: Miles
- POLICY: Minimum job size: Minimum job size is $15,000; smaller leads are referred out.
- POLICY: Margin floor: Gross margin floor is 30%; below that, walk.
- POLICY: Pricing presentation: Materials are billed at cost plus 15% markup, itemized in estimates; labor is never itemized to shopping customers — total-vs-total only. Discounts are rare; prefer scope reduction over price cuts.
- POLICY: Local pricing confirmation: Allowance pricing from national-average retail data must be confirmed against local Tri-Cities supplier pricing before any order is placed.

## Contracts & Payments

- POLICY: Fixed-price contracts only: Fixed-price contracts exclusively; time-and-materials is never used for residential work.
- POLICY: Deposit gates: Demo never begins without the signed contract in hand and the 25% deposit received; payment runs 25% at contract, 25% at demo start, 25% at rough-in inspection, 25% at completion.
- POLICY: Change orders: Change orders are written, signed, and paid in full before the associated work begins.
- POLICY: Rock excavation excluded: Rock excavation is always excluded from base scope; encountering rock becomes a change order, never absorbed.
- POLICY: Warranty terms: Labor is warranted 1 year post-completion; materials are covered per manufacturer warranty.

## Scheduling

- POLICY: No demo without materials: Never demo without the next phase's materials on site, and never schedule a job before the customer's final material selections are made.
- POLICY: Friday punch-list: Fridays are punch-list days, not new demo starts.
- POLICY: Interior trade concurrency: No more than two trades work concurrently inside the building; exterior trades carry no such limit.
- POLICY: Winter weather window: Foundation and framing are not scheduled between mid-December and mid-February; every outdoor-touching phase carries a 20% timeline buffer.

## Quality & Compliance

- POLICY: Permits always: Permits are pulled on every applicable job; skipping permits to save time is never acceptable.
- POLICY: Shower waterproofing: Kerdi or Wedi waterproofing membrane goes behind every tiled shower — non-negotiable.
- POLICY: Job photo documentation: Before, during, and after photos are captured into every job's inputs folder.

## Customer Communication

- POLICY: Monday customer updates: Every active customer gets a weekly Monday update.
